reasoningChain.evidence: I want to grow the squad and continue to the newly unlocked main encounter.
The first clear produced a mythic pair of boots, but the loot record shows equipped power stayed at zero because nothing has been equipped yet.
The complete warrior dealt about 63% of team damage and ranked first in the last combat.
The boots can be equipped on the warrior now, and the visible fit list rates that as one of the strongest fits.
Equipping the striking new item is a low-cost experiment before risking the next encounter, and the warrior has clearer evidence of importance than the untested reserve.
